summary: The headline 28% improvement in match quality is not a clean link-quality comparison: the “before” and “after” links are evaluated with different 1940 middle-initial transcriptions. The repository’s own fixed-validator results reduce the target-sample gain to 16.0% using Ancestry or 11.5% using FamilySearch, while the changed claim registry removes the assertions that previously exposed this discrepancy.

findings.title: The reported 28% match-quality gain changes the validator along with the treatment
findings.what_the_code_does: The old-link file supplies its own `mi1940` to `validated_before=mi1930==mi1940`, while the new-link file separately supplies its own `mi1940` to `validated_after=mi1930==mi1940`. The diagnostic explicitly describes these as moving-validator rates (`vb_own` and `va_own`) because the 1940 initial changes with the transcription being evaluated. The paper nevertheless describes their 65%-to-84% difference as a 28% increase in match quality. Holding the validator fixed produces only 16.0% using Ancestry and 11.5% using FamilySearch in the stored diagnostic results.
findings.why_it_matters: Part of the headline increase comes from changing how the validation outcome itself is read, not from recovering better links. Therefore the abstract, introduction, and main-results claim overstate the improvement in link quality; the reported result is not comparable before versus after as written.
findings.how_to_check: Run `replication/diagnostics/validation_fixed_initials.do`, then compare `valGainTarget` in `replication/results/create_figures_SSHA2025.tex` with `valGainAncTarget` and `valGainFsTarget` in `replication/results/validation_fixed_initials.tex`. Also tabulate `validated_before` versus `validated_after` for records with the same `id_A_before==id_A_after`; under a genuinely fixed validator these flags cannot change.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one pre-specified 1940 initial source for both versions in `create_figures_SSHA2025.do`, regenerate the table and prose, and report the alternative source as robustness. If the moving measure is retained, rename it as a joint transcription-plus-linkage measure and prominently decompose the 28% rather than calling the full amount improved match quality.

findings.title: The claim report turns the disputed validation claims into MATCH by deleting their independent checks
findings.what_the_code_does: The changed registry checks `values = ["valGainTarget"]` and analogous headline values but no longer asserts agreement with either fixed-initial result. Consequently `check_claims.py` merely confirms that the paper’s 28 matches the output of the same moving-validator calculation, and `claims_report.md` now labels the three affected claims MATCH with no known issue.
findings.why_it_matters: The replication report gives false reassurance about the paper’s main quality result. A rerun can exit successfully even though the independent diagnostic still reports materially smaller fixed-validator gains, defeating the stated purpose of the claim-checking layer.
findings.how_to_check: Run `git --no-pager diff HEAD -- replication/claims.toml replication/claims_report.md`; it shows three failed assertions and their explanatory notes being removed, followed by the same claims moving from ASSERT FAILED to MATCH. Compare the reported 28 with the stored fixed values 16.0 and 11.5.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore independent assertions that force the headline metric to agree with the chosen fixed-validator result, or add explicit registered claims for the decomposition and require the paper to disclose both linkage and changed-reading components. Do not mark the claims MATCH solely because prose and the originating moving-metric output contain the same number.

verified_clean.item: Missing ages cannot silently pass the age restriction.
verified_clean.evidence: The changed analysis uses `keep if sex==1 & age>=10 & age<.`, explicitly excluding Stata numeric missing values at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:92-94.

verified_clean.item: Unmatched master records are deliberately retained in the linkage-rate denominator and classified as unlinked.
verified_clean.evidence: Both merges use `keep(1 3)`, while `linked_before` and `linked_after` require `_merge==3 & fiveyr==1`; the subsequent rate denominator counts all retained records at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:66-83 and CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:158-168.

verified_clean.item: The arithmetic for the displayed validation rows uses the nonmissing validation flags and reports their changing sample sizes.
verified_clean.evidence: The code takes `r(mean)` and `r(N)` separately before and after and computes the relative change as `100*((sv_after/sv_before)-1)` at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:191-228. The defect is the moving definition of those flags, not this arithmetic.

verified_clean.item: The independent diagnostic does enforce an invariant for unchanged links under a fixed validator.
verified_clean.evidence: It constructs fixed Ancestry and FamilySearch validators and asserts `vb_src==va_src if status==1` at replication/diagnostics/validation_fixed_initials.do:56-79.

verified_clean.item: The paper appropriately distinguishes external link validation from verified name transcription and notes incomplete reference coverage.
verified_clean.evidence: It states that the genealogical exercise validates links rather than names and that uncovered pairs cannot be confirmed or contradicted at D:\repos\6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb\DHTS-2026-10-12.tex:104-108.

verified_clean.item: The replication master orders the fixed-initial diagnostic after the analysis and before the documented claim-check step.
verified_clean.evidence: The diagnostics are invoked at replication/run_machineA.do:95-106 and the next-step claim checker is printed at replication/run_machineA.do:108-111.

review_limits: The external census data were unavailable, so data-dependent counts and rates could not be independently recomputed.
Stata was not run; runtime behavior was inferred from source and checked against committed replication result files.

The changed diagnostic adds decomposition outputs, but the stored `replication/results/validation_fixed_initials.tex` has not been regenerated and therefore does not contain the new decomposition macros.
This was a diff-scoped review of the uncommitted working tree, not a full audit of every analysis script or paper claim.
